what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in the 18-month transitional period ended June 30, 1974?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1974 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (150 pages) was searched for gross, wages paid, payroll and salary and found only the Treasurer's payroll DEDUCTION totals (p48, p53), the `Special Details Wages` totals (p48, p53), the school payroll clerk in the staff listing (p129) and the school staff listing itself, which names staff with no pay (p127-144) (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the Town's payroll register for January 1, 1973 - June 30, 1974 (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1975, other than the police scale?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1974 report records the Personnel Committee's schedule only as articles (p76: the Classification and Salary Schedule `voted on March 4, 1973`; p83: the April 6, 1974 schedule amended for Police Chief, Sergeant and Patrolman) and prints only the police amounts, which are landed in `report-voted-pay-rates`; searched for classification, salary schedule, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the April 6, 1974 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in the transitional period, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1974 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as three lines of the balance sheet (p43 `Revolving Funds: School Lunch 13,552.00; School Athletics 91.07; Adult Education 12.31`) and the receipts and payments of the same accounts inside the Treasurer's statements (p50, p52); the School Department's own special accounts are landed from p148-149 in `report-school-special-accounts`. Searched revolving and special revenue (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the Town Accountant's transitional-period special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in the transitional period?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1974 report prints no such schedule: article-by-article appropriation balances sit in the balance sheet (p43) and the accountant's schedule (p58-69), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital and capital project (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the Town Accountant's capital projects fund ledger for the period.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1975?
why: `report-valuation` holds the Assessors' tables (assessments by class, valuation and tax history, abstract by class code, overlay, new growth) from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011 onward. The 1974 report prints the real estate valuation ($52,009,970.00), the personal property valuation ($2,908,970.00) and the $44.00 tax rate for fiscal 1975 in the `ABOUT THE TOWN` facts table (p3, table 1, not landed because no dataset holds a facts table) and in the Assessors' prose (p8, with the 1973 comparison figures), the overlay reserved for abatements as a balance sheet line (p44) and the tax collector's levy-year commitments (p70); no table by class and no recapitulation. Searched valuation, overlay, tax rate, new growth, levy (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the Assessors' fiscal 1975 tax rate recapitulation filed with the Department of Revenue.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1974, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1974 report prints, in prose on p33, `In 1974, 31 scales and 40 weights were inspected`, and one receipts line (`Sealing Fees`, p49: 322.60 in Jan-Dec 1973 and 47.00 in Jan-Jun 1974); no device table and no fee schedule. Searched weights, sealer and sealing (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1974 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: How many Lunenburg children were placed out of district in the 1973-74 school year?
why: `placement-counts` holds out-of-district placements from FY2013 onward. The 1974 report predates a placement count: it describes Chapter 766 as a new law (p89, p95, p98) and lists `Aid to Special Classes, Chapter 69` as a receipt (p147), with no count of children placed outside the district. Searched placed out, out-of-district, Chapter 766 and special class (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: the DESE end-of-year pupil report for 1973-74.

what: What are the 1974-75 tuition rates the School Department charged for non-resident pupils?
why: `report-fee-schedule` family `school-tuition-rates` holds per-pupil tuition rates from the 1981 and 1985 reports. The 1974 report prints them on p94 (`1974-75 TUITION RATES`: elementary and middle K-7 $894 and high school $1,177 for September-December 1974; $1,002 and $1,323 for January-December 1975) but p94 returned no table cells (a FINDER MISS, NEEDS.md): the four figures are in lines.tsv only. Searched tuition on every page (sources/data/report-tables/1974/). — closes: a re-read of p94 that returns the rates as a table.
